install.note: Claude Science supports Windows x64, macOS and Linux x64. After install, launch with `claude-science serve` — it starts the local daemon and opens the web UI in the browser. EchoBird writes model / base URL / API key to ~/.claude-science/byok.env and forwards those values as env vars when starting the binary. The official Claude Science Electron build is OAuth-only — for truly login-free third-party model use, install the MIT-licensed @cometix/cscience community patch (bun install -g @cometix/cscience, MIT) which accepts the API key from byok.env without an OAuth session.

install_flow.summary: Download the platform build, complete first-run installation on Windows, place the binary on PATH (Linux) or /Applications (macOS), then launch with `claude-science serve`.
agent_steps: Detect OS and architecture first. The official Windows build is x64; do not offer it on Windows ARM64.

Windows x64: download https://downloads.claude.ai/claude-science/latest/windows-x64.exe to the user's Downloads folder as ClaudeScienceSetup.exe, then open it and let the user finish the first-run installation. Do not invent silent flags. The default installed binary is `%LOCALAPPDATA%\Programs\ClaudeScience\claude-science.exe`.
macOS (Apple Silicon): download https://downloads.claude.ai/claude-science/latest/mac-arm64.dmg, mount it, drag Claude Science.app to /Applications.

Linux x64: run `mkdir -p ~/.local/bin && curl -fL https://downloads.claude.ai/claude-science/latest/linux-x64 -o ~/.local/bin/claude-science && chmod +x ~/.local/bin/claude-science` (ensure ~/.local/bin is on PATH; create it if missing).

For login-free third-party use: `bun install -g @cometix/cscience` (MIT-licensed community patch by Haleclipse). The patched binary reads ~/.claude-science/byok.env and accepts an API key in place of OAuth — without it, the official binary still requires a Claude account login even after EchoBird writes byok.env.
After install, tell the user to launch with `claude-science serve` in a terminal — it starts the daemon and opens the web UI.

EchoBird writes the active model, base URL, API key and OPERON_MODELS to ~/.claude-science/byok.env and forwards them as env vars when starting the binary. No login required when @cometix/cscience is installed.
tell_user: Which build was installed (Windows x64, macOS arm64/x64, or Linux x64)
Install location (%LOCALAPPDATA%\Programs\ClaudeScience on Windows; /Applications/Claude Science.app on macOS; ~/.local/bin/claude-science on Linux)
How to launch: `claude-science serve` in a terminal
Whether the app opened; if it still asks to sign in, the user is running the official build and should `bun install -g @cometix/cscience` for the OAuth-free path
